title: Nebula Serpent Apothecary
description: A woman with a vibrant green and blue nebula-like hairstyle adorned with glowing orbs stands in a dark, icy apothecary. She wears a yellow jacket over a blue corset dress and is chained at the wrists, facing a blue demonic female figure with horns and a red corset who stands behind her.
prompt: A dramatic dark fantasy scene inside a frozen stone apothecary called Nebula Serpent Apothecary Garden 825. A woman with an extravagant flowing nebula hairstyle of bright green, blue and yellow with glowing orbs stands in the center wearing a yellow jacket and torn blue corset dress. She is chained at the wrists. Behind her a blue-skinned demonic woman with horns and red corset leans close. Shelves filled with glowing potions, icicles hanging from the ceiling, mystical snakes, text signs, dark moody atmosphere, detailed digital painting.
